FEDERATION OF MALAYA RUBBER EXCHANGE
(INCORPORATION) ACT 1962

FEDBRATION OF MALAYA Rubber EXCHANGB (AMENDMENT)

RULES 1986

IN exercise of the powers conferred by sections 14 and 16 of the
Federation of Malaya Rubber Exchange (Incorporation) Act 1962,
the Corporation in General Meeting makes the following rules:

1. These Rules may be cited as the Federation of Malaya Rubber
Exchange (Amendment) Rules 1986 and shall be deemed to have
come into force on the 22nd February 1986.

2. The Federation of Malaya Rubber Exchange Rules 1961 are
amended in the manner provided in the Schedule.
